items.title: How many tests bisect needs, as the commit range grows
items.description: This grounds L2 and L3's claim that a binary search over the commit history beats testing commits one at a time: for a range of N commits between the last known-good point and the bug report, bisect converges in roughly ceil(log2(N)) tests, not N. The default below matches L3's rate-limiter scenario: about 500 commits since the last tagged release, converging in about 9 tests.

outputs.label: Tests needed to find the culprit
